findings.finding: Scanning, charging and sample-update Exceptions collapse to one reason; a final-sample Exception is also suppressed once a prior reason exists.
Lexical path validation and lstat followed by pathname scandir do not guarantee no-follow traversal across ancestor or directory-replacement races.
Between-call monotonic checks do not enforce a hard deadline inside a blocked metadata syscall.

historical_conclusion: UNKNOWN: reason, highwater and sample count do not identify the lost exception or establish a present path condition.
proposed_future_direction: Protected fixed-enum/stage/class/errno/root-relative-path metadata for initial and final refusal; descriptor-relative no-follow traversal for a separately authorized future source delta, preserving fail-closed behavior and limits. No historical replay.
